one_liner: QC-4 could not break the Blueberry closure: the deployed auction kick is permissionless and the prior census missed 3 of 5 reward auctions (43.62 cWMON gross), but per-token price floors and the 24h window leave a net fresh-attacker E-U of ~$0.84 dust on Monad; every vault/strategy/admin/proxy/ETH/HL remnant path re-tested reverts or is holder/privileged-only.
